title: Where space rocks land, and why the meteorite record is so lumpy
excerpt: I mapped 45,715 meteorites from the Meteoritical Society's catalogue. 65% were found on Antarctic ice and 24% in hot deserts, while the 1,107 seen to fall follow people, not the sky.
seo_description: A map of 45,715 meteorites: why most were found on Antarctic ice and in deserts, and why witnessed falls cluster where people live.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Where space rocks land' in black, orange and blue on pale paper, beside a world map with orange dots for witnessed falls across Europe, India, Japan and the United States, ochre and purple desert finds in the Sahara and Oman, and blue circles on Antarctica.
